name: Werple
summary: One of WA's earliest ISPs (werple.net.au from Nov 1996); fate unverified (MIRA NETWORKING PTY LTD (later PACNET INTERNET (A) PTY LTD), ACN 085 213 690).

refs.label: ABR: MIRA NETWORKING PTY LTD (later PACNET INTERNET (A) PTY LTD)
